question: Who among the following was awarded the Ramsar Award for 'Wetland Wise Use' in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jayashree Vencatesan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jayashree Vencatesan was awarded the Ramsar Award for "Wetland Wise Use" in March 2025 for her significant contributions to wetland conservation and sustainable management.
 
• The Ramsar Award recognizes individuals, organizations, and governments for exceptional efforts in the conservation and wise use of wetlands.
 
• Jayashree Vencatesan is a renowned environmentalist and the managing trustee of Care Earth Trust, an organization working on biodiversity conservation.
 
• Her work includes promoting community-based wetland management and advocating for policies that ensure the ecological and socio-economic sustainability of wetlands.
 
• The Ramsar Award is one of the most prestigious global recognitions in the field of wetland conservation, presented by the Ramsar Convention on Wetlands.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ramsar Convention:**

 
 
• It is an international treaty adopted in 1971 in Ramsar, Iran, aimed at conserving wetlands and promoting their sustainable use.
 
• The convention designates specific wetlands as "Ramsar Sites" for their ecological significance.
 
• Wetlands play a crucial role in biodiversity conservation, water purification, flood control, and climate regulation.
 
 
 
• **Wetland Wise Use:**
 
 
• Wise use refers to the sustainable utilization of wetlands to maintain their ecological character.
 
• It ensures that wetland resources are used in a way that benefits both biodiversity and local communities.
 
 
 
• **India and Ramsar Sites:**
 
 
• India is home to over 75 Ramsar Sites, making it one of the countries with the highest number of wetlands designated under the Ramsar Convention.
 
• These sites include Sundarbans, Chilika Lake, and Keoladeo National Park, among others.
 
 
 
• **Care Earth Trust:**
 
 
• Care Earth Trust is a Chennai-based NGO focused on biodiversity conservation and ecosystem management.
 
• It works extensively on wetland restoration, urban biodiversity, and climate change mitigation strategies.
